agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host. The runtime supports a visitor-configured MCP server URL in the AI model settings panel.

networks.description: Plan a multi-day city trip: destinations, stays, activities, budget, and a day-by-day itinerary. Answers come only from the site's own city catalog; lodging and activity questions can also consult two linked peer networks.
networks.name: wander
sample_queries: Plan a 3-day trip to Kyoto for two people with a $900 budget.
Where should we stay in Lisbon near Alfama?
What can we do in Vancouver if it rains?
Build my itinerary and save the trip.

peer_policy.note: Peer contact is allowed only to origins listed in allowed_peers (or a peer URL the visitor types in and approves). Every peer contact asks the visitor first; the visitor's LLM key is never sent to a peer site.
